_note: Hand-adjudicated by reading the BSB text in context. 'regions' lists a verdict per double-quoted region in order; 'lead' means the verse OPENS with speech continuing from the previous verse (a closing quote with no opener) and that leading part is Christ's; 'single' means the ‘…’ single-quoted region is Christ's, which is how the BSB renders the Lord's words when someone is quoting Him inside their own speech.

Luke 4:35.why: Jesus rebukes the demon; both commands are His, split by 'He said'

Luke 5:10.why: one speech to Simon, split by the attribution

Luke 5:13.why: 'I am willing' and 'Be clean!' are both His; the first was misread as another speaker

Luke 8:25.why: His question, then the disciples asking one another

Luke 9:59.why: 'Follow Me' is His; the reply is the man's

Luke 18:41.why: His question, then the blind man's answer in two quoted parts

Luke 22:31.why: mid-discourse; the verse is entirely His words to Simon

Luke 22:38.why: the disciples speak first, then His reply

Luke 24:19.why: 'What things?' is His; the rest is Cleopas

1 Timothy 5:18.why: the first quotation is Deuteronomy 25:4; only the second — 'The worker is worthy of his wages' — is the saying of Christ the WEB marks (cf. Luke 10:7)

Matthew 8:3.why: both halves of His reply to the leper

Matthew 9:28.why: His question, the blind men's answer

Matthew 17:23.why: His words continue from v22 and close mid-verse; the rest is narration about the disciples

Matthew 17:25.why: Peter answers first; the remaining two are Jesus questioning him

Matthew 20:21.why: His question, then the mother's request

Matthew 22:19.why: 'Show Me the coin…' continues from v18; then narration

Matthew 26:56.why: His words close mid-verse; then the disciples flee

John 1:38.why: His question; then the disciples' address and their question

John 4:50.why: 'Go' and 'Your son will live' are both His

John 8:33.why: the whole verse is the crowd answering Him — the WEB reddens it only because its \wj span runs on from v32

John 8:39.why: they claim Abraham; the rest is His reply

John 8:41.why: His sentence closes at the start of the verse; the two quoted parts after it are the crowd

John 9:7.why: His instruction; 'Sent' is the evangelist glossing Siloam, not speech

Mark 14:37.why: one rebuke of Peter split by 'He asked'

Acts 9:10.why: the Lord calls Ananias; Ananias answers

Acts 9:15.why: both halves of the Lord's reply to Ananias

Acts 11:7.why: Peter recounting the vision; the Lord's words are the single-quoted span

Acts 11:9.why: as above, the voice from heaven

Acts 11:16.why: Peter quoting the word of the Lord

Acts 22:18.why: Paul quoting the Lord in his defence

Acts 20:35.why: Paul is preaching in his own voice; only the single-quoted saying of the Lord Jesus is His

Acts 26:15.why: two single-quoted speeches: Paul's question, then the Lord's answer — only the second is His

Acts 22:8.why: as Acts 26:15 — Paul asks, the Lord answers

Acts 22:10.why: Paul asks what to do; the Lord's reply is the rest

Acts 23:11.why: 'the Lord stood near Paul and said' — the Lord is the subject; my parser read the addressee Paul as the speaker

Mark 10:49.why: 'Call him.' is His; the rest is the crowd encouraging Bartimaeus

Matthew 8:32.why: 'Go!' is His command to the demons; too short for the general threshold
